snippet.title: Qubic (1968) | The Early History of Video Games | Part 12
snippet.description:
An early 3D Tic-Tac-Toe BASIC game that uses a primitive graphic presentation of the game board. The visual board was added for the 101 BASIC Computer Games book version - you had to keep track of the game board yourself in the original! What a nightmare that must have been...

It's a bit of a pain to play, and the computer is quite good. I can't believe I beat it on my first attempt for the blog. It took a while to figure out how I did it before I got a successful take here.

This game and many other early text-based games can be downloaded and played through Vintage BASIC: http://vintage-basic.net/index.html

Want to learn more? Read about it here: https://obsessivegamingchronology.blogspot.com/2024/07/prehistory-xii-qubic-3d-tic-tac-toe.html
